en.abdullah-al-shahin: (10) Ali bin Ahmad narrated from Obaydillah bin Musa al-Alawi from al-Hasan bin Ali from Abdullah bin Jibilla from some of his companions that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said: “
That matter (the appearance of al-Qa’im) will not occur until a time comes that you spit at the face of each other, curse each other and call each other as liars.”
